Neutrophil count decreased.definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate a decrease in number of neutrophils (ANC) in a blood specimen.

Febrile neutropenia.grade_3: ANC <1000/mm3 with a single temperature of >38.3 degrees C (101 degrees F) or a sustained temperature of >=38 degrees C (100.4 degrees F) for more than one hour
Febrile neutropenia.definition: A disorder characterized by an ANC <1000/mm3 and a single temperature of >38.3 degrees C (101 degrees F) or a sustained temperature of >=38 degrees C (100.4 degrees F) for more than one hour.

Left ventricular dysfunction.grade_1:
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥50% AND one or more of the following:
1) New relative decline in Global Longitudinal Strain (GLS) >15% from baseline
2) New rise in cardiac biomarkers
Left ventricular dysfunction.grade_2:
LVEF 40 - 49% AND one or more of the following:
1) LVEF reduction by ≥10%
2) New relative decline in GLS >15% from baseline
3) New rise in cardiac biomarkers
Left ventricular dysfunction.definition: A disorder characterized by an ASYMPTOMATIC abnormality of cardiac function.
Left ventricular dysfunction.navigational_note: If symptomatic, consider Cardiac disorders: Heart failure.

Heart failure.grade_1: Mild symptoms; no initiation or intensification of treatment
Heart failure.grade_2: Outpatient initiation or intensification of treatment
Heart failure.grade_4: Requiring inotropic support, mechanical circulatory support, or consideration of cardiac transplantation
Heart failure.definition: A disorder characterized by the inability of the heart to pump blood at an adequate volume to meet tissue metabolic requirements, or, the ability to do so only at an elevation in the filling pressure.
Heart failure.navigational_note: If asymptomatic, consider Cardiac disorders: Left ventricular dysfunction.

Blood bilirubin increased.grade_1: >ULN - 1.5 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; 1.0 - 1.5 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Blood bilirubin increased.grade_2: >1.5 - 3.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >1.5 - 2.5 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Blood bilirubin increased.grade_3: >3.0 - 10.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >2.5 - 10.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Blood bilirubin increased.grade_4: >10.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >10.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Blood bilirubin increased.definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate an abnormally high level of total bilirubin in the blood. Excess bilirubin is associated with jaundice.
Blood bilirubin increased.navigational_note: Consider Hepatobiliary disorders: Hepatic failure. Report Autoimmune hepatitis under Hepatobiliary disorders: Other, specify.

Creatinine increased.grade_2: >1.5 - 3.0 x baseline if baseline is below LLN; >1.5 - 3.0 x ULN
Creatinine increased.grade_3: >3.0 x baseline if baseline is below LLN; >3.0 - 6.0 x ULN
Creatinine increased.definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate increased levels of creatinine in a biological specimen.
Creatinine increased.navigational_note: Consider Renal and urinary disorders: Acute kidney injury, Glomerulonephritis, Tubulointerstitial nephritis.

Alanine aminotransferase increased.grade_1: >ULN - 3.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; 1.0 - 1.5 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Alanine aminotransferase increased.grade_2: >3.0 - 5.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >1.5 - 2.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Alanine aminotransferase increased.grade_3: >5.0 - 20.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >2.0 - 4.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN up to 5 x ULN
Alanine aminotransferase increased.grade_4: >20.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >4.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Alanine aminotransferase increased.definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate an increase in the level of alanine aminotransferase (ALT or SGPT) in the blood specimen.
Alanine aminotransferase increased.navigational_note: Consider Hepatobiliary disorders: Hepatic failure. Report Autoimmune hepatitis under Hepatobiliary disorders: Other, specify.

Aspartate aminotransferase increased.grade_1: >ULN - 3.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; 1.0 - 1.5 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Aspartate aminotransferase increased.grade_2: >3.0 - 5.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >1.5 - 2.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Aspartate aminotransferase increased.grade_3: >5.0 - 20.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >2.0 - 4.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN up to 5 x ULN
Aspartate aminotransferase increased.grade_4: >20.0 x ULN if baseline was normal or less than normal; >4.0 x baseline if baseline was >ULN
Aspartate aminotransferase increased.definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate an increase in the level of aspartate aminotransferase (AST or SGOT) in a blood specimen.
Aspartate aminotransferase increased.navigational_note: Consider Hepatobiliary disorders: Hepatic failure. Report Autoimmune hepatitis under Hepatobiliary disorders: Other, specify.
